postconditions.description: The number of nodes in the cactus is between 1 and 5 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the cactus is between n - 1 and 5 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each node and edge in the cactus is numbered between 1 and n, inclusive.
There are no self-loops in the graph.
The graph does not contain any simple cycles with more than two edges.

invariants.description: The graph is a single connected component.
